criteria.name: Technical Capability
criteria.description: Solution architecture, integrations with existing systems, scalability, performance and overall technical fit.

criteria.name: Implementation Plan
criteria.description: Timeline realism, milestones, staffing and team structure, delivery methodology and risk management plan.

criteria.name: Commercial Value
criteria.description: Pricing clarity, total cost of ownership, stated assumptions, payment terms and value for money.

criteria.name: Security & Compliance
criteria.description: Security controls, certifications (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2), data privacy, auditability and regulatory compliance.

criteria.name: Support & Experience
criteria.description: Support model and SLAs, relevant similar projects, client references and track record.

formulas.benchmark: max score per criterion across suppliers
formulas.relative_pct: supplier score / benchmark * 100 (0 if benchmark is 0)
